checks.what: Two independent audits read all 500 cards against the OpenTelemetry documentation and specification they quote, word for word as found by the card checker
checks.result: No wrong answers; 4 unsupported claims, 3 ambiguous cards, 5 unclear ones and 7 minor issues were fixed, and 3 cards that repeated earlier ones were removed.
